THE AIR WHISPERS OF MERCURY'S BACKWARD MARCH, REVEALING HIDDEN MESSAGES.

Mercury Retrograde marks Mercury, ruler of Air element, moving backward as it retraces its orbit, causing communication glitches and a chance to reassess. This period stalls plans and urges you to pause before contracts.

How it affects you: A square to Saturn in the 10th House stalls career, urging caution with contracts. A trine to Venus in the 7th House sparks unexpected love for Libras, yet a conjunction with Chiron reopens old wounds. Those with planets in the 1st House may speak impulsively, so listen before you act.

Shadow side/karmic lesson: This retrograde demands a karmic review of your speech, guiding North Node toward truthful expression. Chiron highlights emotional wounds that need healing now.

Survival tip: Write down vital info, postpone agreements, and double‑check emails until Mercury moves forward.

CTA: Share your Mercury Retrograde story below for a personalized reading!
